0.original: Torn between curiosity and scorn, Maucolyn would report an odd sighting.

1.original: Maucolyn has recently observed a local trader capering in the cold, tossing snowballs in what the dour chocobokeep assumes to be a fit of hypothermic hysteria. Speak with this trader, Duvicauroix, and inquire as to his well-being.

2.original: Happily, there proves to be a method to Duvicauroix's madness. The trader asserts that playing in the snow can warm the body and heart on a cold winter's day more so than even a fire, and teaches you how to /throw a snowball as the first step toward mastering this invigorating form of play...

48.original: I can't see as how I oughta care, but I saw a fella out throwin' snowballs at a snowman. Why anyone'd engage in such japery in the cold, I can't rightly say.

49.original: Went nut gatherin' and lost more'n he found, is my guess. Ye better make sure that don't happen to <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. Not that I know precisely <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103> happened, mind ye.

50.original: What's that? Me? <hex:021A020203>Ask<hex:021A020103>? I got my chocobos to see to. If Duvicauroix wants to upend his head soup on the snow, I can't see what business o' mine it'd be.

51.original: Yep, that's his name─Duvicauroix. I don't know, he sells things, goes places. Don't seem like no kind o' life to me, beggin' pardon. Ye want to see him, I reckon he's somewhere about.

52.original: Walking softly, eh, adventurer? Those around here think I'm winter<hex:021F0103>drunk, I'll wager. Hah! Never seen a snow<hex:021F0103>toss before, the lazy by<hex:021F0103>blows.

53.original: Sit on your arse in front of a poor fire too long, and soon you got the swivin' white<hex:021F0103>knuckles. You'll sleep the better for tossing snowballs, without needing Lady Mead or Mistress Ale to sing the lullaby.

54.original: What do you say, eh? Why not give it a try? It's as simple as you'd imagine. Just reach on down, grab some of the powdery white, and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>throw<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
